bde1b012705eb998c153166a39f041c6f35895a4.sourceText: 源码直接相加，没有对最终角速度限幅或平滑。上游平滑器处理的是相加之前的速度，不能据其限值认定相加后的总量已受同样限制。是否适合实车需结合底盘能力及下位机限制核对，本轮不调整转速。
bde1b012705eb998c153166a39f041c6f35895a4.translatedText: The source code adds the values directly, without limiting or smoothing the final angular velocity\. The upstream smoother processes the velocities before addition, so its limits cannot be used to conclude that the total after addition is subject to the same limits\. Whether it is suitable for a real vehicle must be checked against the chassis capability and lower\-level controller limits; in this round, the rotational speed will not be adjusted\.
